summary.text: R. Kirk McPike is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 5th District, which covers part of the city of Alexandria.
McPike sits on the House committees on Public Safety and Finance.

paragraphs.text: R. Kirk McPike was born in Dallas, TX, according to the House profile.
The profile lists McPike's education as Bachelor of Arts in Political Science, Southern Methodist University.
